field.label: Match
field.help: Which clue about a device to test. Host names, Bonjour models and DHCP vendor classes are regular expressions; a MAC vendor matches a whole word of the maker's name (e.g. Tuya); a domain also matches its subdomains.

field.label: Type
field.help: The device type to show, e.g. Window shade. Your rules are checked before the built-in ones; an override for one device still wins.
